about_short_description.short_description: Scalers is an online competency-based learning and placement platform.

product.name: Talent Sourcing Platform
product.description: A platform that continuously sources and maintains a large database of qualified candidates across various fields for employers to access.

product.name: Competency-Based Candidate Assessment
product.description: A systematic evaluation process that assesses candidates' skills and professional competencies to ensure alignment with job requirements.

product.name: Job Creation and Automation Tool
product.description: A tool that automates and accelerates job posting creation by auto-filling over 80% of job details based on company information and market standards.

product.name: Automatic Candidate Matching System
product.description: A system that automatically matches candidates to job openings based on qualifications, experience, skills, and mutual expectations with a single click.

product.name: Integrated Recruitment Management Platform
product.description: A comprehensive platform that allows employers to view candidate profiles, schedule interviews, send job offers, and track the hiring process in one place.
